mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author_id, visibility, original_post_id, create_time FROM post WHERE visibility = #{visibility} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, title, content, author_id, visibility, original_post_id, create_time FROM post WHERE visibility = 0 AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, create_time DESC
